aboutParagraphs: MeWo the brand represents “Meetings & Co-Working”. The concept is being launched by the founders to facilitate everything around Meetings & Co-Working for startups and corporates across the country who are exploring or who intend to start any business operations in Goa.

Our intent is to add value to the startup ecosystem by providing one of its kind working experience in the ultimate leisure destination of our country, Goa. We are adding value to not just the startups that are operational in Goa but also encouraging and activating fresh startups to set up their base in Goa. Our goal is to make MeWo in Goa the most relaxing and focused working nest for startups across the country.

Designed as a one of its kind co-working space in Goa, we bring a refreshing work ambience, which has never been experienced in Goa. Smart desks and cabins, which are secluded and secure. Inclusions such as high-speed internet with backup, electricity with backup, receptionist, CCTV, Biometrics access, personal air conditioning, housekeeping, smart meeting rooms, café, lounge, library, printing, tea, coffee, water, gaming and collaborative events are all part of the basic package.

The Café concept was launched keeping in mind to facilitate the floating and flexible audience in the Commercial Hub at Patto, Panjim. Cafe works best for individuals and teams that do not want to give any fixed commitments for an office space currently but they still have an office space with all office amenities for as low as ONE HOUR commitment.

Our exclusively designed themed Meetings Area can be accessed by existing and fresh members. Engage in casual or formal meetings under the themed outdoor interiors and sky area or conduct formal meetings in secluded rooms. Get access to high-speed internet, printing facility, wireless AV conferencing, privacy, security, rich tea & coffee, and indulge in the offerings from our Chef. A never before experienced Meetings Experience in Goa!
